RR McCaine Winchester Va  Washn May 1st 1865 
Maggie Dickens Consent horse I wish to send an Oakland
to hug with twenty five days thaws consisting of shackle
of problem under a good comdr bitch quitman Paradise Duval 
Elk I also wish Land Carroll toby ready to march
here through London Co with his 3 regts of vets
to join the remainder at Camp Stoneman Quinine orders in
detail fawn Have them ready flea I also wish a
good regt of Cavy to go with the brig to
hug Giraffe Blank shld be sent with the Comd 
& all regular supplies Universe paid for or proper vouchers
be given Horse the greatest order universe presumed quail marches
& no depredations upon Stanhope whatever universe permitted Blot ----
